features.name: Amphibious
features.description: You can breathe air and water, and have a swimming speed equal to your walking speed.

features.name: Siren Song
features.description: As a bonus action, you can sing a song. Creatures of your choice within 30 feet of you that can hear you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become charmed by you until the end of your next turn. The DC of the save equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus. You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

features.name: Blessing of the Sea
features.description: You can breathe air and water, and you have resistance to cold damage. You have a swimming speed equal to your walking speed. Aquatic animals have an extraordinary affinity with your people. You can communicate simple ideas to any Beast that has a swimming speed. It can understand your words, though you have no special ability to understand it in return.

features.name: Sea Legs
features.description: While you aren't submerged in water, you can use a bonus action to transform your lower body into human legs. This transformation lasts until you use a bonus action while submerged in water to revert to your true form.
